subject: Coordinating VP/CIO attendance + sidecar coverage for StrataCore demo
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chang <alyssa@stratacore.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Coordinating VP/CIO attendance + sidecar coverage for StrataCore demo

Hi Alyssa —

Great to meet you on last week’s call. We’d like to lock a 45–60 minute demo where we can bring in an executive-level sponsor (VP/CIO) from StrataCore alongside your product team so we can address architecture questions live. To make that work on our end we’ll provide a sidecar engineer (in the call to answer deep infra questions) and a short backfill plan if your VP/CIO needs to step out mid-demo.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed Jun 30: 09:00–10:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Thu Jul 1: 10:30–11:30

If the CIO can only do a 30-minute slot, we’ll compress the exec portion to first 20 minutes for priorities and follow with a hands-on demo for the product/eng team. I attached a one-page mutual action plan (StrataCore_MAPlan_v3.pdf) and a short runbook that describes how the sidecar will be introduced (demo-runbook-sidecar.md).

Ask: can you confirm which window best matches the VP/CIO availability and whether they prefer a 30 or 45-minute format? If helpful I can also schedule a 15-minute pre-demo exec intro to align leaders.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0132 | tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: StrataCore_MAPlan_v3.pdf (application/pdf), demo-runbook-sidecar.md (text/markdown)

From: Alyssa Chang <alyssa@stratacore.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Coordinating VP/CIO attendance + sidecar coverage for StrataCore demo

Hi Tessa —

Thanks — this looks good. Quick update on our side: CIO Daniel Park is available Wed Jun 30 but only for a 30-minute window in the morning (too many travel conflicts later that week). VP of Product, Maria Rios, can join the afternoon slot on Jun 30 if we go with the 45-minute format; otherwise she can dial into the compressed session.

A couple of asks from ops/legal: they prefer an exec intro 48 hours before the demo so leaders have context, and they requested a brief one-page security checklist — I can loop in eng-ops@stratacore.com for that.

Can you hold Wed Jun 30 09:00–09:30 PT for the CIO as a tentative? If we confirm the 30-minute format, we’ll keep it tight: 10 minutes of exec alignment + 20 minutes targeted demo. If you can send the calendar invite and pre-demo exec intro invite (15 mins) that would help.

Regards,
Alyssa
Alyssa Chang | Senior Product Manager, StrataCore
alyssa@stratacore.com

Folks —

Thanks Alyssa for the quick turnaround. I can run the sidecar role — here’s the proposed coverage/playbook so internal teams know how to orchestrate if the CIO needs to leave early: 

1) Call structure (30-min compressed):
   - 00:00–00:10: Exec alignment (Tessa + Alyssa + Daniel Park) — confirm top 3 priorities
   - 00:10–00:30: Targeted demo (Vanessa sidecar for infra + Rafael on quantization/cost questions)

2) Backfill plan if CIO stays only for exec portion:
   - We’ll record the 10-minute exec alignment and immediately follow with a 15–20 minute deep-dive recording of the demo content (for the CIO to review).
   - Rafael will capture any action items in the MA plan and tag them in the HubSpot deal record.

3) Calendar and materials:
   - I’ll create two events: a 15-min pre-demo exec intro (Thu Jun 29 09:00 PT) and the 30-min demo tentatively Wed Jun 30 09:00–09:30 PT.
   - Doc links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/StrataCore-67890 (HubSpot account), and I’ll attach the runbook and the MA plan to the calendar event.

Open question: Alyssa, if Maria (VP product) can join later in the day for a 45-min slot, do you prefer we run a separate 45-minute session for the product audience to dive into roadmap alignment, or fold her into the compressed session? Either is fine on our side but I want to be explicit so we schedule the right set of people.

Vanessa Ortiz | Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

Attachments referenced: demo-runbook-sidecar.md

Thanks all —

Per Alyssa and Vanessa: I’ve placed two calendar holds and sent invites: a 15-minute pre-demo exec intro on Tue Jun 29 09:00 PT (execs only) and the 30-minute demo on Wed Jun 30 09:00–09:30 PT (Daniel Park + product/eng). I also created a 45-minute product deep-dive hold Thu Jun 30 15:00–16:00 PT in case Maria prefers to do a fuller session with the roadmap team.

I’ve attached the MA plan to the calendar event and kicked off the DocuSign link for the mutual action plan (https://www.docusign.com/MAPlan/STRC-0421). Rafael — can you please populate the HubSpot record with the three action items Vanessa flagged and set the deal stage to "exec-demo-scheduled"?

Alyssa — please confirm Daniel’s calendar invite and whether eng-ops needs any additional security checklist before the pre-demo; I’ll loop Rafael in if you want Redwood to prep anything extra.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Tessa
